label: latex
definition: A portion of plant substance that is a milky or coloured fluid, a suspension of particles such as terpenoids, proteins and alkaloids in an aqueous medium, held in laticifer cells (PO_0025031) and exuded when the plant is wounded.
reason: Floras in many families use latex colour and consistency as a diagnostic trait (Euphorbiaceae, Moraceae, Apocynaceae, Sapotaceae, Clusiaceae). PO has the precedent of plant resin (PO_0025603) and plant sap under plant substance, but has no latex class, and its plant sap comment names latex as distinct. Propose it to PO upstream.
